dataSourceInstructions:
Tables (schema dbo):
- meta_trust_summary: one row per entity per reconciliation run. checked_at identifies the run; the latest run = rows where checked_at = MAX(checked_at). status PASS/FAIL/PENDING; source_rows, bronze_rows, silver_rows, quarantined_rows, merged_rows, lost_rows (must be 0); bronze_amount, silver_amount, gold_amount.
- meta_reconciliation: one row per check per run (entity, check_name, left_layer/left_value, right_layer/right_value, difference, status, note). Latest run = MAX(checked_at).
- meta_pipeline_runs: one row per pipeline run (started_at, ended_at, duration_s, status Succeeded/Failed, failed_steps, skipped_steps, reconcile_fail).
- meta_pipeline_activity_runs: one row per step of a run (run_id, activity_name, status, started_at, duration_s, error_message).
- meta_load_ledger: one row per table written (layer bronze/silver, entity, rows_in, row_count = rows out, rows_quarantined, rows_merged, logged_at). Rule: rows_in = row_count + rows_quarantined + rows_merged.
- meta_quarantine: one row per rejected row (entity, reason_code, record_key, detail).
- meta_merge_log: one row per merged duplicate (entity, reason_code e.g. EXPORT_RERUN, FILE_OVERLAP).
- meta_completeness: known gaps (entity, gap_type, expected_key = missing day/month/file, detail).
- meta_ai_decisions: AI calls (purpose, input_text, output_text, score, accepted).
- meta_ai_scorecard: AI/rule cleansing quality per defect (system, defect_id, method, cases, correct, precision, recall, f1). Latest = MAX(scored_at).
- meta_defect_detection: planted vs detected defects per system.

Entities: cost, budget, cmdb_assets, cmdb_asset_groups, vm_backup_jobs, vm_backup_storage, license_products, license_entitlements, license_installations.
Rules:
- Tables keep every run; for the current state always filter to the latest run (MAX of checked_at / started_at / logged_at, or the latest run_id per entity).
- Never show _row_hash or survivor_hash unless asked.
userDescription: Trust Ledger: proof that nothing was lost from the legacy sources to Gold. Reconciliation per entity and check, quarantined and merged rows with reasons, completeness gaps, pipeline runs and step errors, AI cleansing decisions and accuracy.
